title: Social media, l'Agcom avvia verifiche con la Commissione Ue sugli algoritmi di Meta. Focus sui contenuti politici
snippet: This news article reports on the decision by Italy's communications regulatory authority (AGCOM) to consult with the European Commission and call researchers to an official hearing. This move was prompted by a study coordinated by Professor Fabio Giglietto, which revealed that Meta's algorithms have an asymmetric effect that penalizes moderate, institutional political actors while favoring extremist ones.
description: An Italian news article reporting on regulatory body AGCOM initiating a review of Meta's algorithms, prompted by a study on political content bias coordinated by Professor Fabio Giglietto.
